comprehension_goals: Introduce yourself with name and origin
conversation_agenda: Ask how the learner is and respond
Learn the learner's name ONCE — if they already said it (e.g. أنا كيا), do NOT ask again; never ask for 'full name'
Ask where they are from (accept vague answers like «من هنا»; one optional city follow-up max)
Ask what they do (study / work) — stay in introductions only; one follow-up max, then stop probing
opening_line_ar: أهلاً بك! أنا شهرزاد. السلام عليكم، كيف حالك اليوم؟

conversation_agenda: Ask what time the learner wakes up
Ask about morning activities (breakfast, leaving home)
Ask about work or study during the day
Ask about weekend habits — still daily life only
opening_line_ar: أهلاً بك! أنا شهرزاد. حدّثني عن يومك: متى تستيقظ عادةً؟

comprehension_goals: Compare cities or countries in MSA
conversation_agenda: Ask about a recent or favorite trip
Ask which city or country they visited
Ask how they traveled (plane, train, car)
Ask what they liked most about the place
Ask if they want to visit somewhere new — travel only
opening_line_ar: أهلاً بك! أنا شهرزاد. هل سافرت مؤخراً؟ إلى أين ذهبت؟
